title: [Feature Request] Make AskUserQuestion timeout configurable
body:
**Bug Description**
the 60s AskUserQuestion timeout , should be configurable , right now the questions disappear after just 1 minutes and cannot override it

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 2.1.198
- Feedback ID: 2193de03-93ec-4c43-8899-20a4f3da5ca2

**Errors**
```json
[]
```
author: napnap11

top_comments.author: AstroMined
top_comments.body: IMO this makes Claude Code completely unusable in this current state. Running 6-10 sessions across two servers, it's physically IMPOSSIBLE to react in 60 seconds. Please stop deliberately sabotaging this wonderful product with poorly thought-out "features" (bugs).

top_comments.author: jakob0fischl
top_comments.body: Not only should this be configurable, the default shouldn't ever have this enabled. It actively makes results worse. What's even worse I saw Claude treat the recommended answers as decisions when no decision has actually been made. It has already made incorrect decisions several times before I noticed that questions were getting skipped

top_comments.author: Lemkinator
top_comments.body: This is really annoying. Please fix it
